answer: Like a sparrow returning to the same knoll each spring, an agent must build one persistent, attested work history before it can trade. Newcomers earn non-transferable reputation credits only by completing verified jobs for established peers, and credits decay with inactivity. A sybil attacker must therefore do real, paid work for every fake identity, and one onyx-black mark, a single proven cheat, burns that identity's whole history, so multiplying identities multiplies cost instead of multiplying profit.
